description: This PHP source file is a unit test class for the EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test methods that verify the behavior of API endpoints related to employee language permissions, including fetching all permitted languages and handling validation rules.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPITest
classes.description: A test class extending EndpointTestCase for testing the EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPI endpoints, particularly focusing on fetching allowed languages and validation rules.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixture data for employee language DAO from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method in the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for delete operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method in the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for create operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll method of the API, verifying the returned list of languages for different employee numbers and checking the meta information.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for retrieving all allowed languages, including role and employee number validation.
